description.value: The Reno Motel is a characterful small motel in Salmo, BC, at the hub of the Kootenays where two main highways meet, placing Nelson, Trail, and Castlegar all roughly 40 km away. Each room is unique — several include a separate bedroom and some feature original claw foot tubs — and the property has communal outdoor BBQ and seating areas. Salmo Ski Hill, which offers mountain biking in summer, is practically at the doorstep, making this a practical base for active touring.

address.value: 123 Railway Avenue, Box 49, Salmo, BC V0G 1Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the motel is actively operating and accepting online bookings. A significant discrepancy exists between the OSM phone number (+1-250-357-9937) and the phone number consistently shown across all website pages (1-604-862-0570); per rule 12, the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged.
